notes.title: July 2024 Update
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1825180/Auro_The_Bunny

We have a new update for [b]Auro the Bunny[/b] and we’d like to share with you the improvements and changes we've made based on player feedback.


[b]Removals[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]Invisible Trap Removed:[/b] An invisible trap in the levels was causing issues due to its lack of visibility. This mechanic has been removed.
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]Jump Adjustments[/b]:
[list]
[*]We increased the jump height by 15%, providing better control and a more responsive gameplay experience.
[/list]
[*][b]Bug Fixes[/b]:
[list]
[*]We resolved several bugs related to invisible collisions that were affecting gameplay in some levels.
[*]We fixed minor issues that were impacting the user experience.
[/list]
[/list]
We will continue working to bring more improvements and new features to [b]Auro the Bunny[/b].

Sincerely,
VM Games
